items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday after Wednesday DNP; consecutive absences with low play probability (~7%) for London game vs JAX. Week-to-week, not long-term per prior Rapoport/Garafolo.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstring; Friday practice key but trending miss
items.opportunity: Lead back role opens fully with Bigsby also IR

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday; paired with Barkley DNPs, ~12% play chance vs JAX.
items.implication: Avoid start; target volume shifts to other PHI WRs if out

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle; Friday practice looms large for Sunday night availability vs ATL (~5% current play chance).
items.why: Ankle injury, consecutive limited/no practice context; Friday decisive
items.implication: Monitor Friday closely; have backup QB ready
items.opportunity: If out, Ravens pass game/TE usage changes (Likely/Andrews)

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis) and will miss multiple weeks per coach Mike McCarthy.
items.implication: Remove from lineups ROS short-term; Steelers WR targets redistribute
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and others gain volume

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury (re-aggravated prior week); not expected vs LAR Monday.
items.implication: Sit Moore; Bills WR depth elevated
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining BUF receivers

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot); second straight DNP, ~49% play chance vs DEN.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston/others see more targets if limited/out

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift limited Thursday (knee/hip) after Wed DNP; Kyle Monangai DNP second straight (thumb/toe).
items.implication: Swift risky but upgrading; monitor Friday
items.opportunity: If both limited, committee/other backs rise

items.text: ETR/Levitan: With Barkley and Bigsby (IR/core surgery) out, 'it's gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville' — elevated three-down lead role expected.
items.why: Teammate absences create clear opportunity; snaps/carries/routes expand
items.opportunity: High snap share, goal-line, receiving work

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) no practice Wednesday/Thursday; low ~4-17% play chance vs CLE, week-to-week.
Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury after tweaking it in drills.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; volume risk vs HOU
items.opportunity: If out, other TEN WRs gain

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Nico Collins @ TEN as his WR8; volume/red-zone hog in favorable matchup.
items.why: Target volume including RZ vs struggling TEN defense

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload plus Bengals injury fallout (Chase/Higgins) boosts.
items.why: Soft run defense matchup and potential pass-game spillover

items.text: Berry LOVES Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume/RZ usage vs weak secondary.
Berry HATES Jordan Addison (WR41 @ NO, injury wrinkle) and Mark Andrews (TE17 @ ATL); tough matchups/thin roles/usage. Also fades Cam Skattebo and Tony Pollard.
